questions.question: I'm preparing a presentation and want to include both interactive UI components and visual diagrams. Can you help me find details on which UI components from Magic UI I can use, especially those with animations? After that, I'd like to generate a visual diagram that maps out how these components interact within the presentation.

I need to visualize the electronic sales trends over the past year using the data from the "Local_Electronic_Sales.xlsx" file. Please generate a column chart with labeled axes and titles. After creating the chart, apply the animated gradient text to the chart's title to enhance visual appeal.

I need to create a customer dashboard for our sales team. We have customer data in the CSV files, and I want to show key metrics like customer distribution by country and purchase frequency patterns. Can you help me create some visual charts for this data, and then suggest some modern UI components that would make these charts look engaging in a web dashboard? I'd like the dashboard to have animated elements that draw attention to important metrics.

I have some application error logs in the logs folder from early February (like ableton-error-2026-02-02.log). I want to write a quick script to parse them and count how many errors occurred per day. Then, I need to display the results on a simple dashboard webpage with a dynamic title and some highlighted stats cards. Can you help me set this up?
